integrity: Only the mathematical statement and attached checks are claimed. Numerical tests do not establish the infinite-dimensional result; the analytical proof does. Earlier equivalent results may exist; independent validation has not been performed.
limitations: All results fix a positive area and take the polygon side count to infinity; polygon orientation affects the phase of the first eigenvector correction; no claims for other spectral bands or uniformity in area.
title: Sharp polygonal Gaussian concentration and a factorial spectral correction
